parts.text: An IGCSE student is investigating the reflection of light by a plane mirror. Fig. 4.1 shows her ray trace sheet. Fig. 4.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The line MR shows the position of a mirror.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw a normal to MR at its centre. Label the normal NL with N at the centre of MR and L on AB .

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Mark a point on AB , 3.0 cm to the left of L . Label this point C. [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Fig. 4.2 shows the mirror which is made of polished metal and has a vertical line drawn on it. The lower end of this line is at point N . Fig. 4.2 In the experiment, the student places a pin P 1 at C . The student views the line on the mirror and the image of pin P 1 from the direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 4.1. She places two pins P 2 and P 3 some distance apart so that the image of P 1 , the line on the mirror, and pins P 2 and P 3 , all appear exactly one behind the other. The positions of P 2 and P 3 are shown.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw the line joining the positions of P 2 and P 3 . Continue the line until it meets the normal.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Draw the line joining point C and point N . [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Measure, and record in Table 4.1, the angle of incidence i between the normal NL and the line CN . Measure, and record in the table, the angle of reflection r between the normal and the line passing through P 2 and P 3 .
